description: This file defines an enumeration 'LocalizedFormats' used for managing localized message formats associated with exception messages in the Apache Commons Math library. It contains constants representing various error message templates, mechanisms for retrieving locale-specific formats, and documentation to aid translators and developers.

classes.name: LocalizedFormats
classes.description: An enumeration implementing Localizable, representing different message formats for localized exception messages in Apache Commons Math.

methods.name: getSourceString
methods.description: Returns the source English format string associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getLocalizedString
methods.description: Retrieves the localized message format string for the enum constant based on the provided Locale. If the resource for the specific locale is unavailable, it defaults to the source English format.
